Q73: added `internal fun attachmentDisplayTitle(title: String?, category: String, capturedAt: String): String` (pure Kotlin, no android imports) plus a private `ISO_DATE` regex, reusing the file's existing private-constant style. Rule: non-blank trimmed title wins (trimmed); otherwise trimmed category, or "Attachment" when the category is blank; if `capturedAt.take(10)` matches yyyy-MM-dd, append " · " + that date. No file name is ever returned or consulted.

- "look like yyyy-MM-dd" implemented as a shape check only (`\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}`), not a calendar-validity check; "2026-99-99" would still render as a date suffix.
- Category is trimmed before display (consistent with the title rule).
